justification: Both surfaces depict essentially the same thing: a tall rectangular field entirely filled with many stacked horizontal lines of small, evenly sized schematic signs, laid out in ruled registers over the full width of a flat vertical panel, which is a fairly specific and conventional scheme rather than a generic pattern. The clearest difference in depicted content is that A carries a distinct figural vignette with larger human/standing figures at the top of the panel and further large figures below the inscribed field, whereas B shows an essentially uninterrupted text field with no comparable large-scale figural scene visible.
